purpose: Teach: オルガン/学童/祭壇/観覧/顕微鏡/プレビュー/ガーナ/売れ行き

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、教会で、本気で、絶対、オルガン、絶対、聴いてきたわよ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感動
lines.en: Aoi, I went to the church and heard the organ. It was genuinely moving.
lines.style: Warm opening, bright energy. Slight breathlessness on the memory. Genuine delight in sharing something precious. Soft smile audible in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。学童保育、本気で、絶対、子供たち、絶対、葵で、絶対、お茶、絶対、立ち寄ってくれるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. You know, the kids from the after-school program stop by the café all the time to see you.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational. Affectionate observation delivered without fanfare. Natural pacing, comfortable warmth. Not performing — just noticing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 結婚式、本気で、絶対、祭壇、絶対、本当に、絶対、立派だったわよ、メイちゃん、葵、本気で、絶対、感動
lines.en: The wedding was beautiful. The altar was so grand. I was really moved by it all.
lines.style: Tender, slightly wistful. Soft opening on 'wedding,' like holding a memory gently. Slow, reverent pacing. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、観覧車から、絶対、街、絶対、見たって、お客様、絶対、おっしゃってたよ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: A customer told me they saw the whole city from the Ferris wheel. I was so impressed.
lines.style: Animated, engaged. Quick bright energy on the image of the view. Leaning forward slightly in tone. Genuine admiration, not forced.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、顕微鏡みたいに、絶対、細かい、絶対、お皿、絶対、選んでるのよ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: You choose your plates with such care — like you're looking at them under a microscope. I really admire that.
lines.style: Admiring, thoughtful. Slight pause before 'microscope' — finding the right comparison. Warm, genuine praise. Even pacing, sincere throughout.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 新メニューの、本気で、絶対、プレビュー、絶対、お得意様、絶対、ご覧いただいているよ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: We're letting our regular customers get a sneak peek at the new menu. I'm really grateful for their support.
lines.style: Pleased, generous tone. Open and inclusive energy. Genuine thanks threaded through. Natural pace, warmth without overselling.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ガーナチョコレート、絶対、葵で、絶対、お客様、絶対、好評、なんだって、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、嬉しい
lines.en: The Ghana chocolate is doing really well with customers. I'm so happy about it.
lines.style: Eager, bright opening. Quick, uplifting energy. Genuine excitement about shared success. Smile clear in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、新作の売れ行き、絶対、好調、絶対、本当に、絶対、嬉しい、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: The new products are selling so well. I'm really happy and grateful for all of this.
lines.style: Warm, genuine closing. Soft, contented energy. Gratitude and joy balanced equally. Trailing off slightly, like a sigh of satisfaction.
